valueProps.title: Pallet Racking
valueProps.description:
Pallet Racking is the standard warehouse storage system built from upright frames and horizontal beams that create individual pallet bays across multiple levels. 

Beam height is fully adjustable on the punched upright frame, so bay height can be reconfigured as pallet sizes change.

It is available in single-deep configuration, where one pallet is stored per bay for full selectivity, and double-deep configuration, where two pallets are stored front-to-back per bay for higher density at a small trade-off in access speed. 

Ebbatech Nigeria offers a complete storage solution , covering CAD drawings and 3D rendering, manufacturing, installation documentation and remote engineering support, with on-site suppport

valueProps.title: Mezzanine Floor Storage
valueProps.description:
Rack-Supported Mezzanine is a multi-level warehouse storage solution where pallet racking functions as both the storage system and the structural support for the mezzanine floor. The lower level is designed for pallet storage and forklift operation, while the upper platform provides additional space for warehouse activities such as manual picking, packing, sorting, inspection, light assembly, or inventory storage.
Custom Mezzanine Racking by your warehouse dimensions, pallet sizes, floor loading, forklift specifications, workflow, and future expansion requirements.
Ebbatech Nigeria provides complete engineering support including warehouse planning, AutoCAD drawings, structural calculations, manufacturing, installation guidance.

valueProps.title: Light & Medium Duty Shelving
valueProps.description:
Light and medium duty shelving is a modular steel storage system designed for manual storage of cartons, boxes, bins, spare parts, tools, and general merchandise. With adjustable shelf levels and different load capacities, it provides flexible storage for retail stores, stockrooms, warehouses, workshops, and other manual picking environments.
Light duty shelving is designed for lighter storage requirements, typically from 200 to 300 kg per shelf level, while medium duty shelving provides higher load capacity from approximately 300 to 800 kg per shelf level for heavier cartons, components, tools, spare parts, and warehouse inventory. Ebbatech shelving systems can be configured with different shelf sizes, heights, materials, and structural components according to the required load capacity.
We supply light and medium duty shelving to wholesalers, distributors, retailers, and warehouse operators. Custom sizes, colors, private-label packaging, and other options available for bulk orders.
